galleries.about.body:
Welcome to *MWNF Galleries*!  
  
This is the right place if you are interested in discovering artefacts according to the material(s) they are made of or according to the type of object.  
  
In *MWNF Galleries* artefacts contributed by Partners from different countries and representing different civilisations are gathered ‘by medium’, showcasing a great variety of artistic expressions and a multitude of perceptions.  
  
After choosing a gallery from the Galleries List, you will be taken to the gallery homepage. The menu bar allows to select from different options.  
  
Within the gallery’s **Collection**, a range of filters offers different ways to explore the material. For research, you can use the **Search** bar located at the top-right of the page. If you are interested in learning about contributions from a specific institution, the **Partner** section would be the best place to start. On the **Timeline**, you will find countries’ historical context information, while [My Collection](https://www.museumwnf.org/mycollection/index.php) lets you save any item from this project for later viewing.  
  
The *MWNF Galleries* database grows constantly thanks to new material added by our Partners. So please come back regularly to check for updates!  
  
Please contact the editorial team at [editing@museumwnf.net](mailto:editing@museumwnf.net) if you experience any problems in accessing web pages or links.
